title: Settings from outside
summary: The greet app says hello to "friend" on a light blue page. Make it greet you on a pink page without touching the code.

tasks.title: A container called `hello`, made from `greet-lab`, is running
tasks.hint: `docker run -d --name hello -p 3400:3000 ... greet-lab`. The image is already built.

tasks.title: `http://localhost:3400` says hello to you, not to "friend"
tasks.hint: The app reads `NAME`. Give it with `-e NAME=Tanvi` before the image name. Settings can't be changed on a running container: `docker rm -f hello` and run it again.

tasks.title: The page is pink, although the image says light blue
tasks.hint: The Dockerfile has `ENV COLOR=lightblue`. A `-e COLOR=pink` on `docker run` beats it.

tasks.title: `app.js` and the `Dockerfile` are unchanged
tasks.hint: Do it all with `docker run`. If you changed a file, put it back as it was (Reset gives you fresh files).
